title: What If Your Phone Caught Fire While Charging?
end_cta: BHEJO USSE JO BED PE CHARGE KARTA HAI
lines: तकिये के पास, फ़ोन से धुआँ!
Takiye ke paas, phone se dhuaan!
गर्मी बढ़ती जाती है: थर्मल रनअवे.
Garmi badhti jaati hai: thermal runaway.
बिना वॉर्निंग, आग लग सकती है.
Bina warning, aag lag sakti hai.
धुआँ ज़हरीला है. सेल्फ़ीज़ बाद में.
Dhuaan zehreela hai. Selfies baad mein.
बाहर से, वन वन टू पे कॉल करो.
कल से: बेड नहीं, टेबल पे चार्ज करो.
Kal se: bed nahi, table pe charge karo.
आपका फ़ोन अभी कहाँ चार्ज हो रहा है?
Aapka phone abhi kahan charge ho raha hai?

post.instagram:
Raat ke 2 baje, takiye ke paas phone se dhuaan 😱

Takiya garmi rok leta hai, battery phoolti hai, aur bina warning aag lag sakti hai. Phone mat uthao, dhuaan zehreela hai (selfies baad mein). Bahar niklo, darwaza band karo, bahar se 112 call karo.

Aapka phone abhi kahan charge ho raha hai? Comment karo BED ya TABLE.

post.youtube_description:
A phone charging under a pillow can't get rid of its heat, and a damaged lithium battery can go into thermal runaway and catch fire without warning. If a device is smoking, don't touch it: get out, close the door and call 112 from outside. Charge on a hard surface with the original charger, and not while you sleep.

Aapka phone abhi kahan charge ho raha hai? Comment karo BED ya TABLE.
